label: ESP32 MMDVM - MQTT Dashboard
info:
# ESP32 MMDVM Hotspot - MQTT Monitoring Dashboard

This flow creates a real-time monitoring dashboard using MQTT pub/sub.

## Prerequisites:

**Install required packages:**
```bash
cd ~/.node-red
npm install node-red-dashboard
npm install node-red-contrib-ui-led
```

Restart Node-RED after installation.

## Quick Start:

1. **Configure MQTT Broker:**
   - Edit the MQTT broker configuration node
   - Set your broker address (e.g., localhost, 192.168.1.100)
   - Set port (default: 1883)
   - Add username/password if required

2. **Set Topic Prefix:**
   - Edit the "Set Topic Prefix" inject node
   - Update the topic prefix to match your hotspot
   - Default: esp32-mmdvm/PD2EMC
   - Format: {hostname}/{callsign}

3. **Access the Dashboard:**
   - Navigate to `http://your-node-red-ip:1880/ui`
   - Dashboard updates in real-time via MQTT

## Dashboard Features:

- **Real-time updates** via MQTT pub/sub (no polling!)
- **System metrics** - Memory gauges, uptime, chip info
- **WiFi status** - Connection state, SSID, IP, RSSI
- **DMR Network** - Login status, server, talkgroup
- **MMDVM Config** - Frequencies, color code, power
- **Station Info** - Callsign, DMR ID, location
- **Modem Hardware** - Hardware details, firmware version
- **Slot Activity** - Real-time DMR transmissions with LEDs
- **Memory history chart** - Track memory usage over time
- **Availability indicator** - Online/offline status via LWT

## MQTT Topics Subscribed:

- `{prefix}/system/status` - System information
- `{prefix}/hardware/modem` - Modem hardware details
- `{prefix}/network/wifi` - WiFi connection status
- `{prefix}/network/dmr` - DMR network status
- `{prefix}/mmdvm/config` - MMDVM configuration
- `{prefix}/station/info` - Station identification
- `{prefix}/slot1/activity` - Slot 1 real-time activity
- `{prefix}/slot2/activity` - Slot 2 real-time activity
- `{prefix}/availability` - Online/offline (Last Will Testament)

## Advantages over HTTP Polling:

✓ Instant real-time updates (no polling delay)
✓ Lower network overhead (push vs pull)
✓ Event-driven slot activity notifications
✓ Scales better for multiple monitors
✓ Works great over internet (MQTT broker relay)

## Customization:

You can adjust:
- Gauge thresholds (edit gauge node settings)
- Chart history length (edit chart node buffer size)
- LED colors and behaviors
- Dashboard layout and grouping
